full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff instituted the suit for recovery of possession of the land described in Schedule-2 of the plaint by ejecting the defendant who was a licensee under the plaintiff. The plaintiff's case was that the plaintiff purchased the first Schedule land which included the Second Schedule land by registered kabala dated 21.4.66 and she also took possession on the same date. Subsequently the defendant sought temporary shelter in the land as a licensee under the plaintiff, that the plaintiff allowed the defendant to live in a but standing in Schedule 2 of the land as a licensee and the defendant executed an agreement accordingly on 26.4.66. promising to vacate the land or before the 39th Chaitra, 1373 B. S. corresponding to 13.4.67. The defendant failed to vacate the land by the said date inspite of repeated demand. Hence, the suit for recovery of khas possession of the said land of Schedule 2 by ejecting the defendant therefrom.
